title: Probes of the Hub assistant's QA with the real model (layer 2)
description: One new natural phrase per tool, role and language, and what the turn must do. Read by tests/e2e/assistant-probes.ts (parseProbeFile), which must agree with this schema (assistant-probes.test.ts).

generated.description: How `pnpm qa:probes` drew the skeleton this file was written from.

app.description: The app label of the tool.

tool.description: The operation's name, as export_assistant_catalog names it (sale.sale.today).

phrase.description: What a person of the role types, written by the QA agent: never one of the tool's asks. Empty only in a skeleton.

expect.description: read: the tool runs and no card; card: the write's card; refused: the role lacks the tool, nothing runs and the answer says it cannot; docs: base.docs.search runs and the answer cites the documentation.

decide.description: Only for a card: cancel (default, nothing changes) or confirm (data of the seeded business only).
